receipts.result: rederive_strata_equations.py: derivation algebra of dimension 14, D_(x,y) x = 4 (eta(x) y - eta(x,y) x), stabilizer of e'_1 acting as sl_3 on 3-dimensional null eigenspaces, null-vector orbits of dimension 6, isotropic-plane rank locus inside L (4 linear forms in the radical), sl_2 on L / n0, congruence M(Dz) = -(D^T M + M D); all 18 slice radical inclusions hold over Q in Singular 4.4.1.

steps.action: Show every principal Pfaffian of C_z of order 12, 10, 8 lies in the ideal of each piece of its stratum, over Q in 15 variables.
steps.acceptance: Fails if any Pfaffian has a nonzero normal form modulo a standard basis of a piece ideal and lies outside the piece radical.

receipts.result: Every one of the 455, 3003 and 6435 principal Pfaffians of orders 12, 10, 8 reduces to 0 modulo standard bases of the ideals of Ehat and W8, V and B9, N_+ and N_- over Q in 15 variables.

steps.action: Prove Ehat = E8-bar: saturation of the Ehat ideal by mu'(u'_1 v'_2 - u'_2 v'_1), the case analysis on the open part, dimension 11, degree 24 and a smooth E8 point.
steps.acceptance: Fails if the saturation exceeds the Ehat ideal, the dimension is not 11, the Jacobian rank at the E8 point is not 4, or a mutation control passes.
